title.en: An Act to Penalize Abuses on Part of the Administrators, or their Agents, of Land Seized By the Government for Delinquency in the Payment of the Land Tax.

text.en:
It shall be unlawful for any administrator or agent of land seized by the Government for
delinquency in the payment of the land tax to strip the abaca, or cause the same to be stripped, in an unusual
and wasteful manner, cut tender abaca plants or cause the same to be cut, or neglect to first clean the grove or
plantation, as is customary, or pick unripe coconuts or cause the same to be picked for any use or purpose.

Any administrator or agent of land seized by the Government who violates the provisions of this
Act shall be punished by imprisonment for not more than two months or a fine of not more than two hundred
pesos, or both.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 5, 1927.
